content: WordPress Plugin Handbook recommends validate/sanitize inbound data, escape at output by context, use dbDelta and versioned upgrade functions for table changes. Current codebase concern audit flags unescaped RSS/CDATA, iCalendar escaping/folding bugs, permissive settings registration, and broad legacy migration surface. Preserve custom tables and template lookup precedence as explicit compatibility contracts. CSV must be tested for quoting, multiline text, formula injection, charset, headers, and partial-import reporting; those detailed recommendations need phase-specific protocol validation.
